summary.text: Randy Brock is the Republican incumbent state senator for the Franklin District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A former state auditor and Army veteran, he was appointed to his current seat in December 2017.

paragraphs.text: Brock was a captain in the U.S. Army Military Police Corps in Vietnam and later worked in risk oversight as an executive vice president at Fidelity Investments; he is a certified fraud examiner.
He earned a B.A. from Middlebury College and an M.A. from Yale University.
Brock served as Vermont State Auditor from 2004 to 2007 and in the state Senate from 2009 to 2013.
He was appointed to the Franklin District Senate seat on December 27, 2017, and became Senate minority leader on January 6, 2021.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Ethics Committee and the Finance Committee.
